Method of Attack: NTLM relay attack using the EfsRpcOpenFileRaw function of the MS-EFSRPC API to force a domain controller to authenticate against a remote NTLM relay under attacker control
Relaying SMB authentication to an HTTP certificate enrollment server allowing full takeover of the domain controller
NTLMv1 downgrade and relaying machine account on computers where the machine account is local admin
Impacted Systems: computers where machine account is local admin (e.g., SCCM, Exchange Server)
Attack Vector: Abuse of MS-EFSRPC API's EfsRpcOpenFileRaw function to force authentication
Relaying SMB authentication to HTTP certificate enrollment server
